emma: Heads-up — kicking off the quarterly least-privilege pass for infra service accounts. First focus: KMS keys with cross-account grants, ownerless principals, and any roles with wildcard admin policies. Timeline: two weeks. If you own infra services, please ack and list any keys/endpoints you own.

raj: scope? full org or just production accounts?

emma: Prod-first, then staging. We'll triage high-risk keys (cross-acct, IAM principal:* grants) within first 72h. Low-risk can wait to week 2.

olga: Quick note — we still have CloudTrail gaps in ap-southeast-1 from last month. I'll attach a query to find keys with no corresponding audit events.

olga: SQL (BigQuery) to find keys with no KMS events in last 90d:
```
SELECT key_id
FROM `audit.logs.kms_events` e
RIGHT JOIN `inventory.kms_keys` k
ON e.key_id = k.key_id
WHERE e.event_time IS NULL OR e.event_time < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
```

emma: nice. For AWS-native folks you can do a CloudTrail query or Athena over S3. Example Athena SQL for missing events:
```
SELECT k.key_arn
FROM kms_keys k
LEFT JOIN (SELECT eventsource, eventtime, resources FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventname LIKE 'Encrypt%') ct
ON ct.resources LIKE CONCAT('%', k.key_id, '%')
WHERE ct.eventtime IS NULL
```

jack: I'll own the owner outreach and carry the CSV. Can you add a filter for cross-account grants only? I can start drafting the email template.

emma: thanks jack. To list keys with cross-account grants (aws cli):
```
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms list-grants --key-id {} --query 'Grants[?PrincipalAccountId!=`123456789012`]' --output json
```
Replace 123456789012 with your account id.

sec-bot: alert: detected 3 keys with grants to unknown-account-ids in prod us-west-2. See /alerts/kms-crossacct-6154328765.

oncall: if we need to rotate/fence a key, what's the rollback? we should avoid app outages.

emma: good call. Runbook: 1) Identify dependent services via CloudWatch metrics and SSM parameter references; 2) Notify owner + 1hr SLA; 3) Rotate with staged re-encryption where possible; 4) If blocking, create temporary limited grant to an ops service account and follow up with permanent remediation. I'll add the full runbook to the ticket.

olga: adding a quick grep command for code references to key ARNs:
```
grep -R "arn:aws:kms:.*:key/" -n services/ | sed 's/:/\t/' > key_refs.tsv
```

raj: can we automate the ownerless detection and create an auto-ticket in JIRA? I'd like to run weekly.

emma: yes — we have a lambda scheduled job we can extend. Action: raj to create the JIRA epic, jack to produce the CSV for initial outreach, olga to run the audit queries and hand off results, sec-bot will post alerts. I'll do the runbook and the permission-check scripts.

jack: drafting email template now, will ping for review in ~2h.

olga: running queries now, will post partial results in this thread when ready.

sec-bot: note: policy-scan found 12 policies with "*:*" in prod; prioritizing high-risk roles.

oncall: acked — will schedule a dry run for rotation on Friday in staging at 03:00 UTC.

emma: thanks all. Please react here with :thumbsup: when you've accepted your assignment. I'll open a tracking ticket and link it here.

raj: 👍

jack: 👍

olga: 👍

oncall: 👍

sec-bot: automated follow-up scheduled in 48h.
